content.title: Material to Use | Product Evidence and Return
content.summary: The source maintains one product identity while associating it with water, cream-like textures and a brief skin-touch use image, returns the product, then ends on an isolated droplet. This is an associative material-to-use-to-product sequence, not observed proof of efficacy. A reusable transfer can strengthen the structure by replacing implication with a practical visible test and bounded outcome.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one stable product shape before close material inserts. + Keep material associations and a brief use context attributable to the same established product; do not mistake source spectacle for observed efficacy. + Return to a readable product view after material and use imagery; an abstract coda may follow.
quick_start.recommended_input: An unbranded reusable cold-drink bottle demonstrates its cap seal, condensation and leak-free short carry before a legible product return.
required_anchors: 材质与使用有可见关系

invariants.rule: Establish one stable product shape before close material inserts.
invariants.purpose: Lets each texture and usage shot refer to the same object.
invariants.ablation_failure: If shape or owner changes, the montage cannot be attributed to one product.

invariants.rule: Keep material associations and a brief use context attributable to the same established product; do not mistake source spectacle for observed efficacy.
invariants.purpose: Links attractive material cues to the product without inventing a measured skin result.
invariants.ablation_failure: If material and use imagery lose their product anchor, the montage becomes generic decoration.

invariants.rule: Return to a readable product view after material and use imagery; an abstract coda may follow.
invariants.purpose: Closes the product-identity chain before any final decorative image.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on abstraction alone without a prior product return weakens the identity payoff.

slots.name: product
slots.constraint: One original unbranded, stable object with consistent geometry.

slots.name: material_test
slots.constraint: Source-level material association or, in an original transfer, one visible practical property test; never claim invisible health efficacy.

slots.name: environment
slots.constraint: A coherent setting that materially participates in the test.

slots.name: user
slots.constraint: Optional clearly adult user, same identity if present.

slots.name: camera
slots.constraint: Product establishing view, material/contact view, use/result view, end product proof.

slots.name: medium_palette
slots.constraint: Original medium and colors; avoid source's blue-white water/flower/cream package.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Original synchronized contact sounds, not source audio attribution.

anti_copy_exclusions: No AQUA LUXE brand, exact label, jar, flower arrangement, splash composition or skin model.
Do not infer measured hydration, medical results or before/after proof from the original clip.
Do not copy the creator's source prompt wording or the exact shot order/cut timing.

instantiations.concept: An unbranded reusable cold-drink bottle demonstrates its cap seal, condensation and leak-free short carry before a legible product return.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original outdoor travel setting, one stable stainless bottle, one adult hiker, one cap closure, water/condensation, sealed bag carry and visible leak-free result.

instantiations.concept: An original insulated lunch box shows a safe carry, then releases visible steam only after its lid opens to reveal the warm meal.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original work-break setting, one stable lunch box and adult worker; sealed carry, then one lid opening with visible steam and meal; no nutritional or health claim.

failure_modes.failure: Product label or geometry shifts between material shots.
failure_modes.repair: Lock one unbranded silhouette, cap detail and surface marks across all views.

failure_modes.failure: A transfer repeats attractive material spectacle but never demonstrates a practical result.
failure_modes.repair: When making a practical claim in an original transfer, show one action and its directly visible bounded result; do not attribute that proof to the source.

failure_modes.failure: Ending loses the product and only shows an abstract droplet.
failure_modes.repair: Hold the product and evidence of outcome together; an abstract coda may follow only after closure.

transfer_tests.concept: An unbranded reusable cold-drink bottle demonstrates its cap seal, condensation and leak-free short carry before a legible product return.
